name: smwmusic-mega-man-construction-dance-guts-man-s-stage-remix
title: Mega Man - Construction Dance ~ Guts Man's Stage (Remix)
description:
*𝗚𝘂𝘁𝘀 𝗠𝗮𝗻'𝘀 𝗔𝘀𝘀 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗲𝗮𝗿𝘀* 𝗜𝗧'𝗦 𝗚𝗨𝗧𝗦 𝗠𝗔𝗡!!!

Did a remix of Guts Man's theme from Mega Man 1 / Mega Man: The Power Battle. Surprised no one has done this this song before, especially given its popularity and Wily having a thing for Guts Man.

Great fit for mountain, industrial, and disco stages.

Important:
- "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also 2 customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. G Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. F# Minor (Power Fighters Pitch)
